states.name: Belgium

routes.scope: Service providers: breach of arts VIII.59 to VIII.62 CDE. Sanction level 2, or level 3 in bad faith

routes.translation: Those who in bad faith commit an offence against articles VIII.59 to VIII.62 are punished with a level 3 sanction.
routes.crossReference: art. XV.70 CDE at Justel https://www.ejustice.just.fgov.be/eli/loi/2013/02/28/2013A11134/justel could not be read; FPS release https://news.economie.fgov.be/251714-directive-sur-l-accessibilite-un-pas-en-avant-pour-une-societe-plus-inclusive/
routes.note: Law text read only on etaamb, a private mirror of the Moniteur. ejustice returned a JavaScript challenge page  and an empty page in the browser. The figure is the regulator summary, not the Code. The summary says administrative sanctions while art. XV.70 levels are penal, and whether surcharges (decimes additionnels) explain EUR 200,000 was not checked. Art. XV.62/7 allows administrative fines for these offences.

routes.scope: Products: breach of royal decrees made under art. VIII.57 CDE. Sanction level 2, or level 3 in bad faith
routes.quote: Sont punis d'une sanction de niveau 2, ceux qui commettent une infraction aux arrêtés pris en exécution de l'article VIII.57.
routes.translation: Those who commit an offence against decrees made under article VIII.57 are punished with a level 2 sanction.
routes.crossReference: art. XV.70 CDE not read
routes.note: Level amounts not read at an official source. Financial services changes under the law of 2 August 2002 not reviewed.

routes.quote: een bestuurlijke boete opleggen van ten hoogste € 900.000, of, indien dat meer is, 1% van de omzet van de onderneming
routes.translation: impose an administrative fine of at most EUR 900,000 or, if higher, 1% of the undertaking turnover
routes.note: Legal reading: art. 15.1(3) gives ACM residual supervision over "other provisions", which appears to include chapter 7a. No ACM statement found. Art. 15.4(5) doubles on repeat.

routes.scope: Consumer banking services, AFM or DNB under the Wft
routes.maximum: EUR 1,000,000 (category 2)
routes.provision: Wft arts 4:22.0a, 1:80, 1:81(2); Besluit bestuurlijke boetes financiele sector art. 10 table
routes.quote: 4:22.0a, eerste en vijfde lid
routes.translation: art. 4:22.0a, first and fifth paragraphs
routes.crossReference: Wft art. 1:81(2) category 2 maximum EUR 1,000,000: https://wetten.overheid.nl/BWBR0020368/
routes.note: The decree lists "first and fifth paragraphs" while the Wft annex to art. 1:80 lists "first and second paragraphs", so the mapping is not clean. Art. 1:81 has higher amounts in special cases we did not map.

states.name: Poland
states.law: Ustawa z dnia 26 kwietnia 2024 r. o zapewnianiu spelniania wymagan dostepnosci niektorych produktow i uslug przez podmioty gospodarcze, Dz.U. 2024 poz. 731
states.authorities: President of PFRON, or the competent market surveillance authority in art. 38(3), for example President of UKE and the minister for digital affairs for e-commerce

routes.scope: Producers, service providers, importers and distributors for the offences listed
routes.maximum: 10 times the average monthly national wage for the prior year, but not above 10% of prior year turnover. No fixed amount in the act
routes.quote: w wysokości do dziesięciokrotności przeciętnego wynagrodzenia miesięcznego w gospodarce narodowej za rok poprzedzający
routes.translation: of up to ten times the average monthly wage in the national economy for the previous year
routes.note: Both limits apply. The wage figure itself was not looked up and no currency conversion is made.

states.name: Portugal
states.law: Decreto-Lei n.o 82/2022, de 6 de dezembro
states.authorities: ANACOM, ERC, AMT, ANAC, IMT, Banco de Portugal, CMVM, ASAE, municipalities, IGAC (art. 28)

routes.scope: Companies: very serious offences, including making non-compliant products or services available (art. 29(1)(a), (4)(a))
routes.quote: Tratando-se de pessoa coletiva, de € 24 000 até ao limiar máximo previsto no Decreto-Lei
routes.translation: For a legal person, from EUR 24,000 up to the maximum threshold set in the Decree-Law
routes.crossReference: DL 433/82 art. 17(2), EUR 44,891.81: https://www.pgdlisboa.pt/leis/lei_mostra_articulado.php?nid=166&tabela=leis
routes.note: Attempt or negligence halves the limits (art. 29(6)). Art. 29(9) requires publication of the decision at the offender expense. DL 433/82 read on the Lisbon Public Prosecutor site, because Diario da Republica needs JavaScript.

routes.scope: Companies: serious offences
routes.quote: Tratando-se de pessoa coletiva, de € 12 000 a € 24 000
routes.translation: For a legal person, from EUR 12,000 to EUR 24,000

routes.scope: Natural persons: very serious offences
routes.quote: Tratando-se de pessoa singular, de € 2000 até ao limiar máximo previsto no Decreto-Lei
routes.translation: For a natural person, from EUR 2,000 up to the maximum threshold set in the Decree-Law
routes.crossReference: DL 433/82 art. 17(1): https://www.pgdlisboa.pt/leis/lei_mostra_articulado.php?nid=166&tabela=leis
routes.note: Attempt or negligence halves the limits (art. 29(6)). Art. 29(9) requires publication of the decision at the offender expense. DL 433/82 read on the Lisbon Public Prosecutor site, because Diario da Republica needs JavaScript.

states.name: Slovakia
states.law: Zakon c. 351/2022 Z. z. (services); products through Zakon c. 56/2018 Z. z.
states.authorities: Slovak Trade Inspection for services under the act and for products (ss.8, 9); sector bodies by special laws

routes.scope: Services in Act 351/2022: failure to meet accessibility requirements or publish information (s.10(1)(a), (b))
routes.maximum: From EUR 200 to 3% of prior period turnover, at most EUR 6,000
routes.quote: Orgán dohľadu môže uložiť pokutu od 200 eur do 3 % obratu za predchádzajúce účtovné obdobie
routes.translation: The supervisory body may impose a fine from EUR 200 to 3% of turnover for the previous accounting period
routes.note: The fine must be waived for (a) and (c) if corrective measures are taken or s.7(1) is shown (s.10(3)).

routes.scope: Services: procedures, notification, corrective measures (s.10(1)(c) to (e)); information and cooperation (s.10(1)(f))
routes.maximum: From EUR 200 to 3% of turnover, at most EUR 20,000; for (f) at most EUR 30,000
routes.quote: výšky 30 000 eur, za správny delikt podľa odseku 1 písm. f).
routes.translation: EUR 30,000, for an administrative offence under paragraph 1(f).

routes.scope: Products: placing on the market without conformity, including not meeting essential requirements
routes.maximum: EUR 200,000; doubled on repeat within one year
routes.quote: Orgán dohľadu nad určenými výrobkami uloží pokutu od 200 eur do 200 000 eur
routes.translation: The product supervisory body shall impose a fine from EUR 200 to EUR 200,000
routes.crossReference: Act 351/2022 s.9 and footnote 22 points to Act 56/2018
routes.note: General conformity act, linked by s.9 of Act 351/2022. Version 28 June 2025; the product technical regulation was not opened, and a later version not checked.

routes.scope: Electronic communications services
routes.note: S.83a sets the duties, but we did not find s.83a in the lists of s.124 in the 28 June 2025 version, so no maximum is stated. Audiovisual route (Act 264/2022) not read.

routes.scope: Products: manufacturer, importer, authorised representative that is a legal person

routes.scope: E-books: medium or large companies
